method: Rows 1-11 of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in file order: the whole file, all 11 check-quotes rows, all in cve-pairs-python-nonhttp (the file had no Python web, JavaScript or PHP rows). None was skipped. For each row I read the gap note entry named in its detail column (benchmarks/gap-notes-2026-11-23-3.json), the fix commit's message and per-file diff (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and the files at the fix commit's parent (gh api repos/O/R/contents/PATH?ref=PARENT, raw), 1.5 s between calls. Each quoted file:line was compared with the parent file; for GHSA-6rmm-3cfr-7939 I also read chirp/drivers/generic_csv.py at the parent to confirm _clean() calls _clean_tmode() per row. 9 notes came out fully ok; 2 needed corrections (GHSA-3j25-mjx3-pwg4 source and between line numbers, CVE-2026-57496 source line range).

notes.source: wrong: agent/src/tools/remember_tool.py:88 memory_type = kwargs.get("memory_type", "project") — the remember agent tool's memory_type argument (documented as one of user/feedback/project/reference); line 89 is the add() call, not the read
notes.between: _save() passes the tool argument straight to MemoryStore.add() (:89); add() only slugifies the *name* (and re-hashes it when empty), interpolates memory_type unslugified into the filename (:304), joins it onto the memory directory (:305) and writes (:320). memory_type="../../x" therefore writes a markdown file outside the memory dir; nothing compares it with the four allowed types (MEMORY_TYPES at :29). Second explanation: source (an agent-tool argument).

notes.source: wrong: src/netlicensing_mcp/tools/products.py:20-22 async def get_product(product_number: str) -> dict: ... return strip_output_fields(await nl_get(f"/product/{product_number}")) — an MCP tool argument interpolated into a REST path (bundles.py, licensees.py, tokens.py and the other tool modules do the same); the return is at :22, not :21
